lead: Cascading selection: the trigger looks like a Select and opens side-by-side columns of menus; the value is a path. Keyboard: up / down to move, right to enter the next column, left to go back, Enter to select.

change-on-select.title: Change on Select
change-on-select.description: Clicking an option at any level commits it; there is no need to reach the last level.

multiple.title: Multiple
multiple.description: Checking a parent checks every available leaf under it. The trigger shows one removable tag per path, and `maxTagCount` collapses the extra ones.

search.title: Searchable
search.description: After typing, the list becomes the matching full paths; from the keyboard, the down arrow moves from the search box into the results.

async.title: Async Loading
async.description: Options marked `lazy` load their next level the first time they are expanded, showing a spinner instead of the arrow meanwhile. Options whose name contains "leaf" come back empty and become leaves.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle it in `cascader.css`; the trigger's look comes straight from each theme style's Select trigger.
styling.trigger: The trigger, which looks like this theme style's Select trigger; `cascader-value` has `data-placeholder` while empty, and the trigger has `data-popup-open` while the popup is open
styling.clear: Clear button, shown when there is a value and `clearable` is set
styling.tags: The tag area of the trigger in multiple selection (the trigger has `data-multiple`; the tags are Tag components)
styling.search: The search box at the top of the popup and the columns side by side below it; while searching the panel has `data-searching`
styling.check: The checkbox of multiple selection, and the spinner that replaces the arrow while loading (the option has `data-loading`)
styling.panel: The columns side by side in the popup; `data-level` on a menu is its column index (from 0)
styling.option: Option: `data-active` when expanded, `data-selected` on the selected path, `data-has-children` with a next level, `data-disabled` when disabled
styling.empty: Empty state when there are no options
